'''Version 0.9.6.0''' is the patch released on 16 November 2026, following [[Version 0.9.5.6]]. Its announcement adds Spanish support and describes display, fuel, combat and interface fixes. The wiki now shows values from [[Version 0.9.6.5]]; no separate 0.9.6.0 binary comparison was made.

'''Spoilers:''' this page names a creature and a story character.

== Changes ==
=== Languages and display ===
Spanish joins the language options, and the Chinese font gains missing characters. The announcement does not give a glyph count for this release.

[[Controls|Balanced Zoom]] works better in windowed mode. In the installed 0.9.6.5 build it uses the actual window dimensions.

=== Fuel and crafting ===
The [[Fire]] menu checks nearby tiles for fuel. Crafting and fire-crafting updates an existing ingredient-loss popup when using materials from nearby containers, rather than creating another popup.

=== Scaalmyr Geomancer ===
[[Scaalmyr Geomancer]] is rebalanced because its XP reward was too high for its threat. Exact values observed in the later build are retained under [[Version 0.9.6.5#Changes_observed_by_0.9.6.5|the comparison through 0.9.6.5]], not as a separate 0.9.6.0 snapshot.

== Fixes ==
=== Combat, rest and exits ===
Weapons with one-tile reach no longer occasionally reach two tiles.

Starting [[Resting|ground rest]] while walking no longer causes the announced movement glitches. [[Ihar]] is moved away from the exit if he blocks it and avoids returning there.

=== Interface and scenery ===
The boat near Fort Solid bobs again. The FPS display uses a consistent color.

Inventories can no longer be linked to ground containers. Menus extending beyond the right edge are pushed further onto the screen, making them easier to grab.

== Announcement ==
[https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1849458702688760 Steam announcement], posted on 16 November 2026 (UTC). These release-specific changes come from that announcement; source-only findings from the direct 0.9.5.6 to 0.9.6.5 comparison remain on [[Version 0.9.6.5]].
